title: Deterministic canonical mission preflight decision
goal: Classify a canonical mission before any builder request as NO_CHANGE, MISSING_WORK, or BLOCKED using durable evidence only.
laws: Preflight never invokes a model, builder, Talos work, Hephaestus work, shell mutation, or network.
NO_CHANGE requires a valid mission preflight artifact bound to the canonical mission and objective.
BLOCKED is reserved for invalid identity, missing canonical envelope, or authority/state conflict.
Otherwise classification is MISSING_WORK; absence of proof is never treated as NO_CHANGE.
Every decision includes evidence paths and keeps authorityGranted/executionStarted false.
Decision output is deterministic and replayable.
Independent Legion verification required before closeout.
